codex_transport_schema.derivation: Mechanical removal of item-level allOf only for Codex structured-output compatibility; canonical validateResponse still enforces the full REVIEWER-SCHEMA semantics.

scope_lineage.derivation: The generic reviewer checklist mechanically restates the pre-audit categories, including placeholder, markup, format and argument-role defects; it does not name the observed positive defect.

public_request.bundle_policy: A fresh private temporary directory contains exactly the four public byte-identical ordinary files bound above: holdout, prompt, canonical schema and Codex transport schema. Bubblewrap 0.11.1 mounts it read-only at the generic /mnt cwd, mounts the host filesystem read-only, hides /home/yun/research with an empty tmpfs, and provides private /dev, /proc and writable /tmp mounts. The host bundle is removed after the call.
public_request.request_construction: UTF-8 PROMPT.md bytes, one newline, the literal header 输入 JSON：, one newline, then compact UTF-8 PUBLIC-HOLDOUT.json JSON.
public_request.outbound_scan: Every user-request and response-schema byte buffer passed to an executable route must pass the frozen fail-closed leak scanner before spawn.

scoring.invalid_route_policy: A failed transport, parser, schema, order, explicit tool-use, explicit identity mismatch, fallback, advisor or subagent check is INVALID_NO_SCORE and is never coerced to NO_DEFECT. One invalid route does not erase other valid route scores.
scoring.tier_policy: PRIMARY_VERIFIED and REFERENCE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED are reported separately. No cross-tier ranking, winner, union, consensus or pooled score is permitted.

required_flags: best-effort feature disables including shell_tool and unified_exec
routes.reason: At the user's explicit direction this route receives an auxiliary reference score despite incomplete file-tool isolation and no server-attested runtime identity. Any observed command/file/Web/MCP/subagent item or explicit identity mismatch makes the candidate invalid.

routes.acceptance: Exactly one init event; only StructuredOutput is exposed or invoked; no MCP server, fallback, non-Opus model usage, advisor signal, parent tool-use/subagent event or server web use; initialized and assistant model are exactly claude-opus-5.
Exactly one assistant message_end; actual provider/model exactly zai-standard-cn/glm-5.3-flash; no tool-call or tool-result event/block.

routes.reason: At the user's explicit direction this route receives an auxiliary reference score although the CLI cannot disable every tool and its runtime envelope does not attest model identity. Explicit tool/fallback/agent signals or an explicit identity mismatch make the candidate invalid.

execution.attempts: Each invocation requires an explicit positive attempt number and atomically creates attempts/<route-slug>/attempt-NNN. Existing attempt or candidate artifacts are never overwritten.
execution.raw_preservation: stdout and stderr are saved byte-for-byte for every spawned attempt regardless of exit status.
execution.parse_separation: run.mjs never produces a candidate; parse.mjs reads preserved raw output and produces a non-overwriting CANDIDATE.json.
execution.environment: An explicit minimal environment-variable allowlist is used. Authentication may be obtained from inherited read-only home/config or provider credential variables, but values and host home paths are never written to artifacts or the user request. All routes run at the generic /mnt cwd inside the frozen OS sandbox; primary routes disable tools mechanically, while reference-only routes retain their declared isolation limitation.
execution.retry: Only harness/transport/parse failures may receive a new explicit attempt. A successful raw envelope is reparsed rather than resampled when only parser compatibility changes.
execution.parallelism: All four routes are independent and may run in parallel after the preflight package is committed and preflight reports GO. The two evidence tiers remain separate after scoring.
execution.reference_only_user_direction: On 2026-08-27 the user explicitly requested auxiliary reference scores even without a fully verified isolation mode. This changes reporting eligibility only; it does not relax outbound sanitization, sealed-reference withholding or invalid-candidate rules.
